properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): "the owner ratified these 18 parts" has no home the design reads. Owner's-word authority attaches only to Requirement status, Decision status and DesignRule enforcement (tools/check_intent_authority.py). A Component carries only BUILD status (planned…verified). And every signature is one AUTHORED_BY edge per (node, contributor), with no act over a set. So a structure the owner accepted is indistinguishable from one an agent drafted
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-09-29, item I26 of art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29.

① OBSERVED (flo2 design 50f966697d6c5024, reflow2 0.74.0). The owner agent wrote "I ratify the 18 parts, with one amendment to part 5". The designer found no act to record it: "Ratifying 18 parts had no single act." The workaround was ONE governed_by from the system root component to the ratification decision, so the link to each part is implicit. Expected: the design says, per part, that the owner accepted it. NOT affected: settling the ratification DECISION itself, which carries the owner's word as usual.

② PRECEDENT. rule:design-intent-moves-only-on-the-owners-word and req:settled-intent-carries-the-owners-name (proposed) both define settled intent by node type. There was no prior record of ratifying structure.

③ CANDIDATES.
(a) SCHEMA: structure nodes have no intent status to settle.
(b) SURFACE: no tool takes a list of nodes to sign.
(c) The observation is wrong: authored_by(role=approver) on each Component would have recorded it, and the designer simply didn't use it.
(d) NOT THE COMPONENT SUSPECTED: on flo2, approver edges could only name Anthony's account, not the owner agent (see fact:root-cause-an-agent-deciding-for-its-principal-has-no-record-because-the-acts-for-rung-was-deferred-2026-09-29).

④⑤ MEASURED 2026-09-29.
· tools/check_intent_authority.py tests three shapes: Requirement off proposed, Decision accepted, DesignRule enforced. Nothing else.
· schema/structure.yaml Component.status is [planned, in_progress, realized, verified], build lifecycle only.
· (c) partly holds: authored_by(role=approver) can be drawn on any node. But no gate, loop read or report reads an approver edge on a Component, so it would be 18 calls recording a signature nothing checks. On flo2 it would also name Anthony, not the owner.
· (b): no served tool takes a node list for a signature.

⑥ CLASS: the owner's-word model covers intent nodes, and an owner's acceptance of STRUCTURE (a parts list, a topology, an interface set), which in systems engineering is the design review's main output, is not a thing the design can hold. The same absence will recur for "ratify the deployment shape" (the round-3 question now pending in the same exercise).

⑦⑧ OWED. No test and no fix. Whether ratification of structure should be modelled at all (a baseline or review record, per-node approver edges read by a gate, or a Decision that GOVERNS a set) is intent, and Anthony's.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED. Whether an existing mechanism (epochs, releases, pin_at_epoch, a baseline) already carries "this set was reviewed and accepted" under another name: not swept.
